title: Calvin Klein perfume: Defy, Eternity, Euphoria and the 10ml minis compared
body:
Calvin Klein fragrances are clean and wearable: lavender and woods for men, fresh florals for women, with a few warmer, sweeter choices. We stock Defy, Eternity, Eternity Aromatic Essence and My Euphoria, many as 10ml miniatures that make easy stocking fillers. Here is every Calvin Klein perfume we stock, with its notes.

Calvin Klein Defy: three versions

  • Calvin Klein Defy Parfum (200ml; the 50ml is out of stock at present): mandarin and pink pepper, then lavender and a suede accord, over vetiver, amber and woods. Warm and smooth.
  • Defy Parfum 10ml Miniature: the same Parfum in a travel spray.
  • Defy Eau de Parfum 10ml Miniature: mandarin and black pepper, then lavender and leather, over vetiver and amber. Fresher and a little sharper than the Parfum.

Defy Parfum or Defy Eau de Parfum? The Parfum has pink pepper and soft suede; the eau de parfum has black pepper and leather. A parfum holds a higher share of fragrance oils; our guide to extrait vs eau de parfum explains the labels.

Calvin Klein Eternity

  • Eternity Eau de Parfum (30ml or 100ml, for women): freesia, mandarin and sage, then lily, carnation, violet, jasmine and rose, over sandalwood, amber and musk. A clean, classic floral.
  • Eternity for Men Eau de Toilette (100ml): mandarin, lavender, bergamot and lemon, then sage, juniper, basil and geranium, over sandalwood, vetiver and musk. Fresh and aromatic.
  • Eternity Parfum 10ml Miniature (for men): lavender and rum, warm spices, over vanilla, woods and amber. Warmer and sweeter.

Our guide to Calvin Klein Eternity for women vs for men compares them in detail.

Eternity Aromatic Essence

Two 10ml Parfum Intense miniatures with a coconut twist:

  • Eternity Aromatic Essence for women: lavender and fresh aromatic notes, then a floral accord and coconut, over amber, woods and musk.
  • Eternity Aromatic Essence for men: juniper berry and fresh aromatic notes, then lavender and a coconut accord, over cardamom, woods and amber.

My Euphoria

Calvin Klein My Euphoria Eau de Parfum 10ml Miniature is the sweetest Calvin Klein we stock: blackcurrant and pink pepper, then orchid, rose and jasmine, over vanilla, amber and woods. A warm floral for evenings.

CK One and Obsession come in the Calvin Klein Women's Miniature Fragrance Set (4 x 15ml), which is out of stock at present: use Notify me on the page.

Which Calvin Klein perfume should you choose?

  • A warm, smooth scent for him: Defy Parfum.
  • Fresh and aromatic for him: Eternity for Men.
  • A clean, classic floral for her: Eternity Eau de Parfum.
  • Something sweeter for her: My Euphoria.
  • Not sure yet: one of the 10ml miniatures.

Good to know

  • The 10ml miniatures make easy stocking fillers: see our mini perfume sets guide and stocking fillers guide.
  • Every bottle is 100% authentic and dispatched from the UK, with free UK delivery over £40.

Shop every Calvin Klein fragrance, or browse perfume for men and perfume for women.
